result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations from the Riemann–Siegel style asymptotic expansion: power-series coefficients $a_n$ of an exponential with recursion relations, Gaussian integral representations via $\Pi(n-\frac12)$, a differential equation for the generating function $v$, a substituted series $w=\sum d_n y^n$ with recursions for $d_n$ when $\alpha=i\sqrt{2\pi t}$, and Gamma-function reflection identities.
result.transcription:
$e^{x(-\frac{1}{2}y+\frac{y^3}{6\pi i})+\dots}$
$= e^{(\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}-\frac12)\log(\alpha+y)-\frac{\alpha}{2\pi i}y+\frac{y^2}{4\pi i}-(\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}-\frac12)\log\alpha}$
$=\sum a_n y^n$

$\frac{\partial^2(vyy)}{\partial y^2}=\sum_0^\infty c_{n-2}n(n-1)y^{n-2}$

$\frac{1}{y}v=-\frac{1}{\alpha}y^{\frac12}\frac{\partial vy^{\frac12}}{\partial y}+\frac{1}{\alpha 2\pi i}\frac{\partial^2 yyv}{\partial y^2}yy+\frac{1}{y}$

methods.what: Power series expansion of an exponential of a logarithmic expression in y
Three-term recursion for the coefficients a_n
Gaussian moment integrals expressed via Pi (Gamma) function; odd moments vanish
methods.quote: $(2\pi i)^{n+\frac12}\Pi(n-\frac12)=\int_{-\infty}^\infty e^{-\frac{yy}{2\pi i}}y^{2n}\partial y\qquad\int_{-\infty}^\infty e^{-\frac{yy}{2\pi i}}y^{2n+1}\partial y=0$

methods.what: Representation of d_0 as a series summed into a contour integral
Differential equation for generating function v of c_n
Substitution v = w e^{-πi/(2yy)} and power series for w
Recursion for d_n with alpha = i sqrt(2πt)
Expression of d_1 in terms of d_0
Gamma reflection formula applied to Pi functions
